$comment: Rulebook metadata. verifiedDate is stamped when the rule files were last reconciled against sources.
verificationMethod: Each rule was checked against multiple independent sources (official issuance digests, government announcements, and top-tier tax firm alerts) on August 26, 2026, covering the attachments/eAFS rulebook (RMC 49-2020 through RMC 46-2026 line) and the 2026 filing-season one-offs (RMC 20-2026, 30-2026, 39-2026, 46-2026). Values not yet corroborated by at least two independent sources carry confidence: needs_review in the data files, a maintenance flag for the next verification pass. Re-checked in the review of October 7, 2026 (REVIEW.md): the corrections through that date are in (among them Proclamation No. 1427 s.2026, Wage Order NCR-28, RR 26-2025, RMC 98-2026, RMC 14-2024 and RMC 91-2024); rules the review could not confirm are marked needs_review and shown as unconfirmed. Re-checked again in the audit of November 8, 2026 (AUDIT-2026-11.md) by web search (the BIR, SEC and law-library sites could not be opened from the audit environment, so firm alerts, news reports and search-indexed issuance texts were used): added RR 6-2026 and RMC 112-2026 (creditable withholding tax on invoices), RMC 47-2026 (business closure), the SEC Notice of Apr 14, 2026 (2025 AFS moved to June 15, 2026) and SEC MC 16-2026, Proclamation No. 1447 s.2026 (NCR-only holidays, Nov 16-18, 2026), HDMF Circular 499-2026 (Pag-IBIG remittance schedule replaced; Pag-IBIG employer dates now unconfirmed) and RMC 84-2026; confirmed that no law changing the graduated table or the ₱90,000 cap had been enacted, and that no extension of the Dec 31, 2026 e-invoicing or micro-abatement deadlines had been issued.
howToUpdate: All rates, thresholds, deadlines, forms, attachments, and holidays live in src/data/rules/*.json. Change the value, update legalBasis/notes, set confidence, and bump verifiedDate here. The calculators, labels, help text, form guide and blog read these values (src/engine/ruleText.js builds the words), so changing a rate, threshold, cap or due date needs no code change. A new kind of rule, or a change to how a rule works (a new bracket structure, a new exemption, a different rounding), still needs a code change and new tests. Known future checkpoints: the 2027 Eid'l Fitr and Eid'l Adha proclamations (the rest of 2027 is per Proclamation No. 1427 s.2026, added Oct 7, 2026); the 2028 holiday proclamation (expected Sept–Oct 2027); each year's SEC MC for the calendar-year AFS date (FY2025's moved May 29 → June 15 mid-season); each year's AITR RMC for season-specific attachment deadlines; EOPT 3-year CPI adjustments of the ₱3M VAT threshold and ₱500 invoice floor (~Jan 2027); pending TY2027 bills on the graduated table and the ₱90k/₱120k bonus cap; the NCR-27 wage-order injunction; each January's alphalist-module release; the RR 11-2025 e-invoicing go-live (first group Dec 31, 2026); the RR 4-2026 micro-taxpayer abatement window (closes Dec 31, 2026); the RMC 112-2026 invoicing-system dates for the withholding-tax field (Dec 31, 2026 and Mar 31, 2027); the new Pag-IBIG remittance due days under HDMF Circular 499-2026; any BIR advisory on NCR deadlines that fall on the Nov 16-18, 2026 ASEAN Summit holidays.
